recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸顆粒普魯士藍（Prussian blue）染色，整個顆粒被大量深藍綠色的含鐵血黃素占滿，周圍紅血球呈橘棕色，表示儲存鐵明顯增加；若放在缺鐵的情境，此圖其實是「鐵充足」的對照，而非缺鐵。
features: Large marrow particle diffusely laden with dark blue-green hemosiderin
Iron deposits are coarse and confluent throughout the particle
Background red cells stain orange-brown with the counterstain
Thick particle and focus limit assessment of individual macrophages and sideroblasts
describe_en: Prussian blue-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large marrow particle diffusely and densely laden with coarse, confluent blue-green hemosiderin, set against orange-brown red cells. Storage iron is markedly increased (approximately grade 4+ to 5+ in this field). Individual macrophages and erythroid precursors cannot be evaluated for sideroblasts in this thick, slightly out-of-focus particle. These findings exclude iron deficiency and indicate abundant storage iron, as seen in iron overload, anemia of inflammation, or ineffective erythropoiesis; thin areas should be examined for ring sideroblasts.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency shows absent stainable iron in particles, the opposite of this image.
Overload produces markedly increased particle iron like this, with supporting history of transfusion or high ferritin/transferrin saturation.
Requires identification of ring sideroblasts (at least 5 perinuclear granules encircling a third of the nucleus) in erythroid precursors in thin areas.
Macrophage iron is normal to increased with decreased sideroblasts and low serum iron with normal or high ferritin.
